dict.string: StructSense scans for Bluetooth humidity and temperature sensor pucks so you can watch moisture in a crawlspace or closed room.

StructSense plays a low-frequency tone through the speaker and listens with the microphone to compare how a suspect wall section absorbs sound against a dry reference spot. Audio is processed on the device and never stored or uploaded.
StructSense reads the magnetometer to flag metal studs, pipes and fasteners behind a wall while you sweep the phone across it.
